articles.title: U.S. senators urge Treasury not to leave states out of GENIUS Act stablecoin process
articles.snippet: Senators led by Republican Cynthia Lummis are insisting the Treasury Department ensure states get a process to prove their ability to supervise stablecoins.

articles.title: Hyperliquid, Uniswap and Worldcoin buck crypto slump as traders chase AI, DeFi trends
articles.snippet: A handful of tokens continued their run while bitcoin and the rest of the crypto market stalled after the early week bounce.

articles.title: Binance says its European regulatory application is compliant despite report of Greek rejection
articles.snippet: An EU crypto license application by the world’s largest crypto exchange is set to be rejected by the Greek regulator HCMC, according to a report from Reuters.

articles.title: Binance says it considers EU license compliant amid reports of potential rejection
articles.snippet: Without specifically calling out a report on Binance’s EU license, the crypto exchange warned that any rejection forcing it to delay activities in the region could “weaken liquidity” and present other potential risks.

articles.title: Anthropic shutdown makes a strong case for decentralized AI: Grayscale
articles.snippet: Grayscale says decentralized AI tokens gained after the US government ordered Anthropic to cut access to its latest AI models, showing user demand for alternatives to centralized AI.
